propositions: After b690 makes req.config effective, plan-review's Pass-1 finder runs on haiku (trivial rung) instead of opus, quietly weakening the blocking-findings gate.
The downgrade is silent: a weaker Pass-1 yields a PASS that gets signed, and the sidecar records only the verifier's model, so it is invisible in artifacts.

Archaeology shows Pass-1 generated findings on opus until 2026-06-27, after which _verifier_cfg's downgrade collapsed Pass-1 onto sonnet, making its docstring claim 'the Pass-1 finder is unaffected' false.
The fix is a restoration: set plan-review.yaml model_ladder rung 0 from trivial to frontier so findings generate on opus, while Pass-2 verify and Pass-4 coach stay on sonnet.
Tests must assert the effective Pass-1 model at the runner seam and that Pass-1 and Pass-2 resolve to different models under default config, since asserting YAML text is insufficient.
The prerequisite finder's pack_prerequisite_bins sizes to cfg.model, so with haiku it packs for a 200k window instead of sonnet's 1M, spuriously triggering context-limit escalation.
